plans.name: Future-Ready Course of Study (classes of 2027–2029)

subjects.label: English
subjects.notes: English I, II, III, and IV in order

subjects.label: Mathematics
subjects.notes: NC Math 1, 2, and 3, plus a fourth course that fits your plans after high school

subjects.label: Science
subjects.notes: A physical science, Biology, and an earth/environmental science

subjects.label: Social Studies
subjects.notes: Founding Principles/Civic Literacy, Economics and Personal Finance, American History, and World History

plans.notes: For students who entered grade 9 from 2021-22 through 2025-26. Includes 4 more elective credits from any subject.

plans.name: Future-Ready Course of Study (class of 2030 and later)

subjects.notes: NC Math 1, 2, and 3, plus a fourth course that fits your plans after high school

subjects.label: Science

subjects.notes: New for students entering grade 9 in 2026-27. Students who enroll after grade 11, or whose IEP prevents it, take one more elective instead.
